title: Hurry up! / I can see some ... but I can't see any ...
subtitle: 快点！/ 我能看见一些……但看不见任何……

lead.question: 你让朋友沏壶茶，他却连茶叶、茶杯在哪儿都找不到——这说明了什么？你会用 can 表达「会不会、能不能」吗？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象你第一次被指派沏茶：先找水壶里有没有水，再找茶叶、找茶杯。每一步你都可能说「我能看见……但看不见……」。英文里「能/会」用情态动词 can，它本身不表示动作，只表示能力或可能，后面永远跟动词原形。先试着用 I can see ... / I can't see ... 描述你厨房里找东西的过程，再听 Sam 怎么手忙脚乱地找茶叶和杯子。
goals: 能用情态动词 can 表示能力：I can see ... / I can't see ...
掌握 can 的否定 can't 与疑问句 Can you ...?
能用 there is / there are + some / any 说明某处有什么
会用方位词 behind / in front of / over there 描述位置
lead.summary: 第 43 课 Penny 让 Sam 沏茶，Sam 一步步找：水壶里有水吗、茶叶在哪儿、茶杯在哪儿——全程用 can 和 there is。因为 Sam 不常沏茶，连茶叶（在茶壶后）、茶杯（在碗橱里）都要 Penny 指点，最后 Penny 催 Hurry up, Sam. The kettle's boiling. 第 44 课用 I can see some ___ , but I can't see any ___ 操练 can 配合 some/any。
lead.tips: ① can 是情态动词，后接动词原形，无人称/数变化：I can see. / He can find.；② 否定 can't（= cannot），疑问 Can you ...? 把 can 提前；③ some 用于肯定，any 用于否定和疑问；④ behind 与 in front of 互为反义（方位）；before/after 表时间；⑤ The kettle's boiling 里 kettle 借代「壶里的水」（借代修辞）。

questions.a: Because he can't find the tea or the cups — Penny has to tell him where everything is.

questions.hint: 听 Sam 一直问 Where's the tea? / Where are the cups?

questions.a: It's over there, behind the teapot.

questions.q: Why does 'can' never change to 'cans' or 'caned' even after he/she/it?
questions.zh: 为什么 can 在 he/she/it 后也不变 cans、caned？
questions.a: can is a modal verb: it has no person/number change and is always followed by a base verb. Ability is shown by can itself, not by ending changes.
questions.aZh: can 是情态动词，无人称/数变化，后接动词原形；能力由 can 本身表达，不靠词尾变化。

questions.q: I can see some spoons, but I can't see any knives. / I can see some hammers, but I can't see any boxes.
questions.zh: 第 44 课操练：I can see some ___, but I can't see any ___.
questions.a: I can see some coffee, but I can't see any loaves of bread.
questions.aZh: 我能看见一些咖啡，但看不见任何面包。
questions.hint: some 肯定，any 否定；loaf 复数为 loaves。

grammar.title: 情态动词 can（能力）
grammar.definition: can 是最常用的情态动词之一，表示体力或脑力方面的能力或客观可能；它本身不表示动作，须与其他动词连用，无人称和数的变化。
grammar.usage: I can see some coffee. / Can Sam read this book?

examples.en: I can see the teapot.
He can find the cups.

grammar.title: can 的否定式与疑问句
grammar.structure: can't (cannot) / Can + 主语 + 动词原形?
grammar.definition: can 的否定式为 can not / cannot / can't；疑问句把 can 提到句首，后接主语和主要动词。
grammar.usage: I can't see any coffee. / Can you make the tea?

examples.en: I can't see the tea.
Can you find them?

grammar.title: there is / there are 结构（复习）
grammar.structure: There is + 单数/不可数；There are + 复数
grammar.definition: 表示「某处有某物」，动词 be 的单复数由后面的主语决定；并列名词时若第一个是单数，动词仍用 is。
grammar.usage: There is some tea in the cup. / There are some cups in the cupboard.

examples.en: There is some water in this kettle.
There are some in the cupboard.
